description: This file defines the SugarModule class, which manages module instances, loading beans, and checking module templates within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarModule
classes.description: A class for managing CRM modules, including retrieving instances, loading beans, and verifying module templates.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an instance of SugarModule for a given module name, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the module with a specific name.

methods.name: moduleImplements
methods.description: Checks if the module implements a specified template.

methods.name: loadBean
methods.description: Loads and returns the bean object for the current module, optionally returning a boolean if $returnObject is false.
